variants.label: JVM (Java 25, JIT)
variants.rationale: The baseline everything else is compared against, and the only build that JIT-compiles from a profile gathered during the run itself.

variants.label: Native, -Os, serial GC
variants.rationale: Optimised for image size. Halves the binary against -O3 and was the default until measurement showed the size is paid on the registry rather than on the node.

variants.label: Native, -O3, serial GC
variants.rationale: The current default. Faster than -Os where memory is not the constraint, and identical to it where it is — the serial collector becomes the bottleneck before the code quality does.

variants.label: Native, -O3, G1 (Oracle GraalVM)
variants.rationale: The variant that tests whether the collector was the limit: under sustained load the serial collector spent 32% of wall-clock time collecting, with pauses reaching 1.9s.
